capabilities: Open and edit code files with syntax highlighting in a Monaco Editor view
Edit individual Markdown code blocks in a modal and sync changes back
Configure which file extensions open in the code editor
Customize editor theme, font family, font size, line numbers, indent guides, and minimap
Create new code files via shortcut icon buttons or commands
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not open VSCode; it embeds the Monaco Editor (the VSCode editor kernel) inside Obsidian.
extras: The README is translated from Chinese and contains copy-paste errors (the manual install section says to extract an 'obsidian-image-toolkit' folder, inconsistent with this plugin).
motivation: The author built it because Obsidian by default does not support viewing and editing of various code files.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit code-format files by default, forcing users to switch to a separate editor for code files in the vault.

relations.evidence: It is based on Monaco Editor (VSCode Editor kernel) development

summary: Monaco Editor-based plugin that lets you view and edit code files (C, Python, JavaScript, YAML, and more) inside Obsidian.
